jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Was du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey IT Solutions AG erbringt für die Emil Frey Gruppe verschiedene, zentrale ICT-Dienstleistungen und verwaltet die Server-Backend Systeme in zwei Datacenters zusammen mit der Hybrid-Cloud Infrastruktur für ca. 10'000 User, welche an über 100 Standorten in Europa arbeiten. Für die IT-Infrastructure-Abteilung am Standort Zürich-Altstetten oder Safenwil, suchen wir eine/n Network Security Engineer Welche Aufgaben wirst du übernehmen
• Sicherstellung des stabilen und sicheren Betriebs der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur im Rechenzentrum
• Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur
• Bearbeitung von Störungen im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support
• Erstellung technischer Konzepte, Systemübersichten sowie umfassender Dokumentationen
• Planung und Durchführen von Umstellungen und Systemwartungen Was du mitbringst
• Fachausbildung in Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Firewall und Security-Plattformen, vorzugsweise von Fortinet
• Erfahrung mit Sicherheitslösungen (Cisco ISE, NAC, Web-Proxy) sind von Vorteil
• Kenntnisse in Skriptsprachen wie Python sind von Vorteil
• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
• Hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
• Bereitschaft zum Pikettdienst Was dich bei uns erwartet Du findest bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien Wie du uns kontaktieren kannst Wir freuend uns auf deine vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.
• Sicherstellung des stabilen und sicheren Betriebs der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur im Rechenzentrum
• Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der zentralen Firewall-Infrastruktur
• Bearbeitung von Störungen im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support
• Erstellung technischer Konzepte, Systemübersichten sowie umfassender Dokumentationen
• Planung und Durchführen von Umstellungen und Systemwartungen
• Fachausbildung in Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von Firewall und Security-Plattformen, vorzugsweise von Fortinet
• Erfahrung mit Sicherheitslösungen (Cisco ISE, NAC, Web-Proxy) sind von Vorteil
• Kenntnisse in Skriptsprachen wie Python sind von Vorteil
• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
• Hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
• Bereitschaft zum Pikettdienst

descriptionByLocale.it:
Quello che dovresti sapere su di noi Il Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda svizzera a conduzione familiare con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e attenzione al cliente sono i pilastri portanti dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marchi automobilistici, sulla gestione di garage, sulla logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori e sulla fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG fornisce vari servizi ICT centralizzati per il gruppo Emil Frey e gestisce i sistemi di back-end del server in due data center insieme all'infrastruttura cloud ibrida per circa 10.000 utenti che lavorano in oltre 100 sedi in Europa. Per il reparto IT Infrastructure nella sede di Zurigo-Altstetten o Safenwil, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Network Security Engineer Quali compiti svolgerai
• Garantire il funzionamento stabile e sicuro dell'infrastruttura centrale del firewall nel data center
• Continuo sviluppo dell'infrastruttura centrale del firewall
• Gestione dei guasti nel supporto di 2° e 3° livello
• Creazione di concetti tecnici, panoramiche del sistema e documentazione completa
• Pianificazione ed esecuzione di conversioni e manutenzione del sistema Cosa porti
• Formazione specialistica in informatica o qualifica comparabile
• Esperienza pluriennale nel funzionamento di firewall e piattaforme di sicurezza,
descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family business with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG provides various central ICT services for the Emil Frey Group and manages the server backend systems in two data centers together with the hybrid cloud infrastructure for approx. 10,000 users working at over 100 locations in Europe. For the IT infrastructure department at the Zurich-Altstetten or Safenwil location, we are looking for a Network Security Engineer What tasks will you take on
• Ensuring the stable and secure operation of the central firewall infrastructure in the data center
• Continuous further development of the central firewall infrastructure
• Processing of disruptions in 2nd and 3rd level support
• Creation of technical concepts, system overviews and comprehensive documentation
• Planning and implementation of conversions and system maintenance What you bring with you
• Specialist training in computer science or comparable qualifications
• Several years of experience in the operation of firewall and security platforms,

descriptionByLocale.it: Cosa dovresti sapere su di noi La Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. Le attività sono focalizzate sull'importazione di marche automobilistiche, l'esercizio di garage, la logistica di parti di ricambio e accessori, nonché la prestazione di servizi finanziari. La Emil Frey IT Solutions AG fornisce per il Gruppo Emil Frey diversi servizi ICT centrali e gestisce i sistemi di backend server in due data center insieme all'infrastruttura di cloud ibrida per circa 10.000 utenti, che lavorano in oltre 100 sedi in Europa. Per l'unità IT-Infrastructure presso il sito di Zürich-Altstetten o Safenwil, stiamo cercando un Amministratore di Rete. Le tue responsabilità - Assicurazione del funzionamento stabile e sicuro della rete LAN e WAN europea - Risoluzione di problemi nel 2° e 3° livello di supporto - Creazione di concetti tecnici, di panorami dei sistemi e di documentazioni complete - Pianificazione e esecuzione di trasferimenti e manutenzioni dei sistemi Il tuo profilo - Laurea in Informatica o una qualificazione equivalente - Esperienza di più anni nel gestire reti WAN, LAN e WLAN, preferibilmente sul portafoglio Cisco (Meraki, Classico e Nexus) - Esperienza con soluzioni di sicurezza (Cisco ISE, NAC, Web-Proxy) - Conoscenza di linguaggi di scripting come Python è utile - Capacità di lavoro autonomo e piacere per la collaborazione interdisciplinare - Alta consapevolezza della qualità e della sicurezza - Buone conoscenze in tedesco e buone conoscenze in inglese - Disponibilità a prestare servizio di turnazione Cosa ti offriamo - Numerose agevolazioni (auto nuove e usate, lavori di servizio e parti di ricambio, assicurazioni di veicoli e malattie, carte di benzina, alberghi e molto altro) - Una propria, attraente cassa di pensione come ente di previdenza indipendente - Una prospettiva di lungo termine per l'azienda - Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali - Almeno 25 giorni di ferie Come puoi contattarci Siamo felici di ricevere la tua candidatura completa (ad esempio, curriculum, attestati di lavoro, ecc.) via il link "Candida ora!". Per motivi di leggibilità, si è deciso di non utilizzare contemporaneamente le forme grammaticali maschile, femminile e diverso (m/w/d). Le identità di genere femminile e diverse vengono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa per noi che le persone lavorano in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i risultati migliori. Siamo convinti che un personale diversificato e una cultura integrativa ci permettano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
What You Should Know About Us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the cornerstones of the company. The activities are focused on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG provides various central ICT services for the Emil Frey Group and manages the server backend systems in two data centers together with the hybrid cloud infrastructure for approximately 10,000 users, who work at over 100 locations in Europe. For the IT Infrastructure unit at the Zürich-Altstetten or Safenwil site, we are looking for a Network Administrator. Your
• Responsibilities - Ensuring the stable and secure operation of the European LAN and WAN infrastructure - Handling disruptions in 2nd and 3rd level support - Creating technical concepts, system overviews, and comprehensive documentation - Planning and performing migrations and system maintenance Your
• Profile - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification - Several years of experience in operating WAN, LAN, and WLAN infrastructures, preferably on the Cisco portfolio (Meraki, Classic, and Nexus) - Experience with security solutions (Cisco ISE, NAC, Web-Proxy) - Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python is an advantage - Independent working style and pleasure in interdepartmental collaboration - High quality and security awareness - Good German language skills and good English language skills - Willingness to perform shift work What We Offer You - Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more) - A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund - A long-term corporate perspective - Individual opportunities for further education and development - At least 25 days of vacation How to Contact Us We look forward to receiving your complete application (e.g., curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply Now!". For reasons of better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms male, female, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means to us that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse staff and an integrative culture enable us to exploit our full potential.

Descrizione What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family business with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories and the provision of financial services. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG provides various central ICT services for the Emil Frey Group. This also includes the further development and support of MS Dynamics F&O for Mobility AG of the Emil Frey Group. As the IT Competence Center Mobility, we represent the link between the various specialist areas of Mobility AG and “classic IT”. To expand our team in Glattbrugg, we are looking for an IT Consultant MS Dynamics. In this position, you will help shape our digital transformation and actively influence the further development of innovative business processes. You work closely with different departments and international teams on future-proof, sustainable IT solutions. Mansioni - Carrying out business analyses, documenting requirements and process mapping - Conception and implementation of individual adjustments in collaboration with development and project management - Functional installation and configuration of MS Dynamics 365 Finance - Coordinating the tests for the release changes together with the key users - Carrying out key user training, go-live support - Accompanying process improvement - 2nd and 3rd level support after project completion - Carrying out business analyses, documenting requirements and Process mapping - Conception and implementation of individual adjustments in collaboration with development and project management - Functional installation and configuration of MS Dynamics 365 Finance - Coordination of the tests for the release changes together with the key users - Carrying out key user training, go-live support - Accompanying process improvement - 2nd and 3rd level support after project completion
• Requirements - Completed studies or specialist training in the field of computer science or comparable training - At least 5 years Relevant professional experience - Ideally experience in the automotive or financial sector - Several years of experience in consulting ERP systems, ideally MS Dynamics 365 Finance - Interest in Microsoft Cloud products - Open, communicative personality with the courage to proactively approach the specialist areas - Structured, analytical, solution-oriented and independent way of working with a strong customer focus and joy in cross-team collaboration - High quality and security awareness - Team spirit, initiative and a pragmatic “can-do” mentality - Very good Knowledge of spoken and written German and good knowledge of English - Completed studies or specialist training in the field of computer science or comparable training - At least 5 years of relevant professional experience - Ideally experience in the automotive or financial sector - Several years of experience in consulting ERP systems, ideally MS Dynamics 365 Finance - Interest in Microsoft cloud products - Open, communicative personality with the courage to approach the specialist areas proactively - Structured, analytical, solution-oriented and independent way of working with a strong customer focus and enjoyment of cross-team collaboration - High quality and safety awareness - Team spirit, initiative and a pragmatic "can-do" mentality - Very good knowledge of spoken and written German and good knowledge of English
• Cosa offriamo - A key position with scope for creativity and personal responsibility in an innovative environment - Participation in strategic projects to further develop the mobility solutions of tomorrow - Modern work equipment, attractive office space and flexible working hours (home office partially possible by arrangement) - Short decision-making processes and an appreciative, supportive team - Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more) - Our own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund - A long-term business perspective - Individual training and development opportunities - At least 25 days of vacation Contatto How you can contact us We look forward to receiving your complete application (including... CV, references, etc.) via the “Apply now!” link. For reasons of better readability, the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) are not used at the same time. Female and other gender identities are expressly included. For us, diversity also means that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and differences. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to achieve our full potential.

La Emil Frey Gruppe non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marche automobilistiche, l'esercizio di garage, la logistica di parti di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. La Emil Frey AG Altendorf è il partner ufficiale di vendita e assistenza per le marche Mercedes-Benz, Opel e Suzuki e dispone di una carrozzeria e un magazzino di parti di ricambio. Mansioni - Eseguire lavori di diagnosi, riparazione e manutenzione - Analizzare e risolvere problemi tecnici ed elettronici con l'ausilio di sistemi di diagnosi moderni - Assicurare l'osservanza di standard di qualità e sicurezza, nonché supportare il capo della officina - Partecipare regolarmente a corsi di formazione e aggiornamento specifici per le marche
• Requisiti - Laurea di scuola professionale in meccatronica automobilistica EFZ con specializzazione in diagnostica automobilistica o in formazione per il ruolo di diagnostico automobilistico, MB Systemtechniker - Esperienza consolidata nel settore della diagnosi automobilistica - Abilità analitica, strutturata e orientata al risultato - Elevato senso di responsabilità, affidabilità, impegno e determinazione - Disponibilità a partecipare a corsi di formazione interessanti per rimanere aggiornato sulla tecnologia più recente - Orientamento al cliente, atteggiamento positivo e possesso di un valido patentino di guida di categoria B
• Cosa offriamo - Numerose agevolazioni (auto nuove e usate, lavori di servizio e parti di ricambio, assicurazioni di veicoli e malattia, carte di credito per carburante, alberghi e molto altro) - Una pensione di vecchiaia attraente come ente di previdenza indipendente - Una prospettiva di lungo termine per l'azienda - Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo individualizzate - Minimo 25 giorni di ferie Contatto Vanessa Aminger, Responsabile regionale per il personale, si compiace della completa presentazione della candidatura (ad esempio, curriculum, attestati di lavoro, ecc.) tramite il link "Candidato ora!". Per motivi di leggibilità, si è deciso di non utilizzare contemporaneamente le forme grammaticali maschili, femminili e diverse (m/w/d). Le identità di genere femminili e altre sono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa per noi che le persone lavorano in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i migliori risultati possibili. Siamo convinti che una squadra di lavoro diversificata e una cultura integrativa ci permettano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive sector. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. Activities focus on the importation of automotive brands, the operation of garages, logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Altendorf is the official sales and support partner for the Mercedes-Benz, Opel, and Suzuki brands and has a body shop and a spare parts warehouse.
• Responsibilities - Perform diagnostic, repair, and maintenance work - Analyze and resolve technical and electronic problems with the aid of modern diagnostic systems - Ensure compliance with quality and safety standards, as well as support the workshop manager - Regularly participate in specific training and updating courses for the brands
• Requirements - Professional degree in automotive mechatronics EFZ with specialization in automotive diagnostics or training for the role of automotive diagnostician, MB Systemtechnician - Consolidated experience in the field of automotive diagnostics - Analytical, structured, and result-oriented skills - High sense of responsibility, reliability, commitment, and determination - Availability to participate in interesting training courses to stay up-to-date with the latest technology - Customer-oriented, positive attitude, and valid category B driving license
• What we offer - Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and illness insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more) - Attractive old-age pension as an independent pension fund - Long-term perspective for the company - Individualized opportunities for training and development - Minimum 25 days of vacation Contact Vanessa Aminger, Regional Personnel Manager, welcomes the complete submission of the application (e.g., curriculum, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Candidate now!". For readability reasons, it has been decided not to use the grammatical forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other identities are explicitly included. Diversity means to us that people work in teams that, thanks to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse and integrated team and a culture of integration enable us to fully exploit our potential.

• Sviluppo e implementazione di strategie di vendita e acquisizione mirate

• Collaborazione stretta con i produttori e le interfacce interne
• Monitoraggio del mercato e identificazione di nuove opportunità di business

• Conoscenze approfondite nel settore della gestione di flotte, leasing e soluzioni di mobilità

Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The activities focus on the import of automobile brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG, Züri-Oberland Volketswil is the official sales and service partner of the exclusive brands BMW and MINI and creates fascination and joy of driving. Your tasks
• You sell new cars successfully
• A customer-oriented, comprehensive consultation and a consistent care of existing and new customers according to the premium standard are for you self-evident
• You develop for your customers suitable financing and insurance solutions
• You create offers as well as attractive exchange and leasing offers
• You carry out an active acquisition of new customers
• You process incoming leads professionally, competently and promptly
• You take care of the showroom Your profile
• Completed commercial vocational training or a comparable qualification
• Several years of experience as a sales advisor in the automotive industry
• Customer contact is your passion and you have a developed sales flair
• You convince through a sovereign and cultivated appearance
• Flexibility, resilience, empathy and a future-oriented way of thinking are among your central strengths
• You share our enthusiasm for the automotive industry and bring passion for the MINI brand
• A structured and precise way of working, negotiation security as well as a developed customer orientation complete your profile
• Stylish German in word and writing, further foreign languages are an advantage
• Category B driving license What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual further education and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holiday How to contact us Chiara Staccioli, Regional Personnel Manager, is looking forward to the complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the forms of speech masculine, feminine and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities lies on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey Betriebs AG provides logistics services for goods and vehicles and is therefore the hub in the flow of goods between our customers and their end consumers. Your tasks
• Handling of administrative matters for train and truck deliveries
• Handling of special cases such as: exhibitions, Drive-Away, events
• Monitoring of deadlines, delivery and return of company cars to employees of the importers
• Optimization and design of processes on the preparation site/workshops
• Handling of customer complaints/damage reports
• General administrative tasks that occur in the management Your profile
• Commercial education completed with knowledge in the automotive industry or technical education in the automotive industry, (preferably mechanic/motor EFZ) completed with commercial knowledge (e.g. commercial school)
• Corresponding professional experience
• High IT affinity, evaluations, tables, graphical representations
• Good knowledge of the German language in words and writing, communication also in French and English possible
• You are able to think and make decisions
• Flexibility, service orientation, and good communication skills complete your profile What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities

We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The activities focus on the import of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG, Wädenswil, is the official sales and service partner of the Mercedes-Benz, Mercedes-EQ, and Mercedes-AMG brands and has a body shop, a spare parts warehouse, and a textile washing facility. Your responsibilities
• Execution of vehicle orders and monitoring of delivery dates
• Creation of vehicle invoices, preparation of work orders, and collection of vehicle premiums from the importer
• Recording and publication of vehicles
• Coordination with manufacturers, suppliers, and transportation service providers
• Communication with internal departments such as sales, preparation, and accounting
• Maintenance of customer and vehicle data Your profile
• Completed commercial education, preferably in the automotive industry
• Work experience in vehicle disposition
• Careful and solution-oriented work with fast learning ability
• Good knowledge of German in writing and speech, further foreign languages are an advantage What we offer you
• Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• An attractive and independent pension fund as a separate pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual opportunities for further education and development
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Vanessa Aminger, Regional Personnel Manager, looks forward to receiving your complete application (e.g., curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means to us that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the cornerstones of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey Digital AG is part of the Emil Frey Group and is a full-service communication service provider for the automotive industry and responsible for digitalization within the Emil Frey Group. To strengthen our digital marketing team in Zürich-Oerlikon, we are looking for a Team Leader Business Analyst to be hired immediately. Your tasks
• Provide professional and operational leadership of the business analytics team
• Operate in analyses, report creation, performance and customer journey analysis
• Analyze and interpret marketing, customer, and campaign data to derive data-based recommendations
• Develop KPI frameworks, reporting structures, and data-driven decision-making processes
• Identify optimization potential along the customer journey and support conversion and performance optimization
• Manage and prioritize analytics, tracking, and performance projects
• Collaborate closely with departments, media, CRM, product, business, and data teams
• Ensure high data quality and develop tracking, tagging, and attribution concepts
• Support data-driven marketing and business strategies
• Develop team members and promote a data-driven company culture
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business informatics, business administration, data analytics, or equivalent qualifications
• More than 6 years of experience in the field of digital marketing, business analytics, or marketing analytics
• 2-3 years of leadership experience or a developed ability to lead and develop teams
• Good understanding of digital marketing channels, customer journeys, and data-driven marketing management
• Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Google Analytics, SQL, Looker Studio, BigQuery, or Power BI
• Analytical, structured, and solution-oriented thinking with high numerical affinity
• Hands-on mentality and pleasure in operational participation
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Good knowledge of German and English in writing and speaking. What we offer You will find with us a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• A own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual development and training opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation. How to contact us We look forward to receiving your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link 'Apply now!'. For better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and non-binary identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey Betriebs AG provides logistics services for goods and vehicles and is thus the hub in the goods flow between our customers and their end consumers. Your tasks
• Packaging of spare parts at the various dispatch stations
• Invoicing of spare parts
• Courier trips
• Customer service at the collection counter
• Coordinating and processing mass dispatch orders
• General assistance in the Warenausgang department Your profile
• Completed vocational training as a logistics coordinator
• Work experience in the Warenausgang area
• Good physical fitness
• Category B driving license
• Forklift certificate (preferably)
• Good knowledge of German
• High quality awareness and pleasure in team work What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• Your own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual opportunities for further training and development
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Modjda Assadian, employee of personnel/administration, looks forward to receiving your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link 'Apply now!' Due to better readability, the simultaneous use of the grammatical forms masculine, feminine and diverse (m/f/d) is dispensed with. Female and other gender identities are explicitly meant. Diversity means that people work together in teams that, through their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce, as well as an integrative culture, enable us to fully exploit our potential.

Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey Baden in Oberrohrdorf offers a touch of British Cars, as an exclusive service partner for Jaguar and Land Rover. Your tasks
• They actively support our sales team in the success-oriented sale of certified Jaguar and Land Rover brands. From the first contact, accompany and advise our customers on vehicle selection as well as on financing and insurance options
• They support vehicle deliveries and contribute to a high level of customer satisfaction and sustainable customer support. Building and maintaining customer relationships and acquiring new customers are gradually part of your area of responsibility. They help with the maintenance and management of the car park and ensure an attractive vehicle presentation
• Assistance at events and exhibitions as well as close cooperation with our departments (workshop, spare parts warehouse and customer service) are also part of your area of responsibility
• Support of the sales manager in administrative work
• Analysis and evaluation of offers on Autoscout24 and Carmarket
• You will continue to develop your profile through targeted training and practical support as an independent sales consultant
• You are interested in sales and want to develop in car sales – First sales experience is beneficial, but not mandatory
• Your customer- and service-oriented personality as well as your communicative nature set you apart
• They have a commercial flair and enjoy dealing with people
• A high level of self-motivation, willingness to learn and enthusiasm for cars bring you with you
• You are interested in new technologies, trends and digital tools
• You work independently, responsibly and integrate well into a motivated team
• Stylistic German in words and writing, other foreign languages are an advantage
• You are in possession of the driving license category B What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holidays
• Great loyal team, large customer base for many years
• Modern working conditions
• A leadership culture with confidence and promotion
• 2 premium brands that inspire and challenge
• Long-term development opportunities How to contact us Vanessa Aminger, Regional HR Manager is looking forward to the complete application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better legibility, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is omitted. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity also means for us that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to realize our full potential.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce que vous devriez savoir sur nous. Le Groupe Emil Frey n'est pas seulement une entreprise familiale suisse avec 100 ans d'expérience, mais également l'une des principales entreprises de l'industrie automobile. Qualité, tradition, innovation et orientation client sont les piliers de l'entreprise. Les activités sont axées sur l'importation de marques automobiles, l'exploitation de garages, la logistique de pièces de rechange et d'accessoires, ainsi que la fourniture de services financiers. L'Emil Frey AG de Volketswil est le partenaire de vente et de service officiel des marques Mercedes Benz, Kia, Opel, Mazda et Suzuki et dispose également d'une carrosserie et d'un entrepôt de pièces de rechange. Vos responsabilités
• Vente réussie : vous êtes responsable de la vente de véhicules neufs et d'occasion de la marque innovante KIA
• Conseil au client : vous offrez un conseil orienté client, complet et professionnel, et vous assurez une prise en charge constante et professionnelle des clients existants et nouveaux
• Service complet : vous créez des offres personnalisées, des estimations de change, des offres de location et d'assurance
• Gestion des relations : vous maintenez activement notre clientèle existante et gagnez de nouveaux clients avec enthousiasme
• Présence au point de vente : vous assurez notre accessibilité et effectuez des services le samedi au showroom
• Événements : vous travaillez activement sur les expositions et les événements des clients
• Expérience de vente : vous apportez au moins deux ou trois ans d'expérience de vente réussie, préférablement dans l'industrie automobile ou le secteur des services
• Passion pour l'automobile : vous avez une grande passion pour l'industrie automobile et êtes enthousiasmé par la vente d'automobiles
• Personnalité gagnante : le contact avec le client est votre force absolue. Vous convainquez avec un comportement sûr et raffiné, ainsi qu'avec un fort flair de vente
• Mentalité de service : une forte orientation client, un haut idée de service et des compétences de négociation sont vos caractéristiques
• Flexibilité : vous êtes résilient, prêt à apprendre et apportez la volonté de travailler le samedi
• Compétence linguistique : vous vous exprimez avec confiance en allemand et avez de bonnes connaissances en anglais. D'autres langues étrangères comme le français ou l'italien sont un grand avantage
• Volonté de réussite : vous avez un vrai mindset de gagnant avec un focus sur l'atteinte des objectifs et une grande initiative personnelle
• Mobilité : vous avez un permis de conduire valide de catégorie B Ce que nous offrons à vous. Vous trouverez avec nous une nouvelle challenge avec des tâches excitantes et beaucoup d'autres choses encore :
• De nombreuses avantages (véhicules neufs et d'occasion, travaux de service et pièces de rechange, assurance, cartes de carburant, hôtels et beaucoup d'autres choses)
• Une pension attractive comme une caisse de pension indépendante
• Une perspective d'entreprise à long terme
• Des opportunités individuelles de formation et de développement
• Au moins 25 jours de vacances Comment vous pouvez nous contacter. Chiara Staccioli, responsable régionale du personnel, se réjouit de votre demande de candidature complète (par exemple, curriculum vitae, attestations de travail, etc.) via le lien "Candidater maintenant !" Pour une meilleure lisibilité, nous avons décidé de ne pas utiliser simultanément les formes grammaticales masculines, féminines et diverses (m/w/d). Les femmes et les autres identités de genre sont explicitement incluses. La diversité signifie pour nous que les personnes travaillent dans des équipes qui, en raison de leur unicité et de leur diversité, atteignent les meilleurs résultats. Nous sommes convaincus que des équipes diversifiées et une culture intégrative nous permettent d'exploiter notre plein potentiel.

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automobile brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The MultiLease AG can look back on over 30 years of experience in the field of vehicle financing. It is the official financing company of the Emil Frey Group and, as such, the official leasing partner of the group's import companies and their brand representations. With its experienced employees, it belongs to the leading automotive leasing companies in Switzerland. Your tasks You will conduct independent debt collection processes for the companies of the Emil Frey Group, as well as cases from leasing law, including judicial enforcement or defense
• Active support in daily business, as well as participation in the optimization of processes and guidelines and their documentation
• Point of contact for internal departments in matters of leasing law
• Independent risk and success assessment of claims
• Drafting of lawsuits, as well as requests for opening of proceedings for the realization of claims
• Legal examination and processing of all defect notifications from leasing customers with a focus on risk minimization for MultiLease AG
• Legal defense against conversion, retention, and guarantee claims
• Independent development of penal matters (in particular, fraud and embezzlement) and preparation of penal complaints
• Leadership and accompaniment of proceedings in collaboration with external lawyers and authorities, including representation in mediation proceedings
• Ensuring a high level of case processing quality, complete case management, and profound legal evaluation, as a basis for escalation to the group's internal legal department Your profile
• Bachelor's degree in Law (MLaw) or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration HF/Business Economics FH with focus on finance and law
• Experience in debt collection, claim management, or in a comparable legal

• Du empfängst die Kunden und unterstützt sie bei der Wahl des passenden Fahrzeuges.

• Du liebst den Umgang mit Kundschaft und eine lebhafte Atmosphäre.

• Neben Berufserfahrung im Kundendienst oder in einer Verkaufsfunktion kannst du dich auch gut in Englisch verständigen.

• Hektische Situationen bewältigst du mit konstanter Freundlichkeit und Gelassenheit.

The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey Digital AG is part of the Emil Frey Group and is a full-service communication service provider for the automotive industry, as well as responsible for digitalization within the Emil Frey Group. To strengthen our key account team, we are looking for a key account manager in Zurich for immediate start or after agreement a key account manager / key account manager / key account manager. Your tasks
• You will execute innovative digital, analog and cross-media projects for leading brands of the Emil Frey Group - from the first idea to the successful go-live phase. In this way, you shape the brand communication and contribute significantly to the success of our brands.
• You are the point of contact for our customers and advise them comprehensively on digital and analog services. You develop creative concepts and tailored solutions that increase the long-term success of our customers.
• You are responsible for budget, deadline, quality and resources and ensure that all projects are structured and efficiently executed.
• You accompany our customers with passion and use the opportunity to present your ideas and contribute actively to the development of internal processes.
• You establish a continuous improvement management and ensure that process optimizations are regularly checked and adapted. In this way, you collect feedback, improve measures and promote a culture of continuous improvement. Your profile
• You have a degree in digital marketing, communication or a related field
• You have at least 5 years of work experience in the marketing field, preferably in the agency sector
• Show high performance both in team and alone, be resilient and willing to take responsibility. Your results are the business card of your work and the expression of your high quality standards
• You are sure in customer consulting and project acquisition and can present your ideas and concepts convincingly
• French and Italian language skills are an advantage
• You are able to multitasking, prioritization and coordination of various stakeholders
• You have experience with Microsoft Office, Jira & Confluence. What we offer You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• Your own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation. How to contact us We look forward to your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce que vous devez savoir sur nous Le Groupe Emil Frey n'est pas seulement une entreprise familiale suisse de 100 ans d'expérience, mais également l'une des principales entreprises de l'industrie automobile. Qualité, tradition, innovation et orientation client sont les piliers de l'entreprise. Les activités sont axées sur l'importation de marques automobiles, l'exploitation de garages, la logistique de pièces de rechange et d'accessoires, ainsi que la fourniture de services financiers. Notre culture d'entreprise vit du recul mutuel, de la proximité avec les personnes et de la collaboration authentique à tous les niveaux. Nous sommes convaincus que le succès durable se développe là où les personnes se sentent écoutées, soutenues et développées. Exactement là commence notre travail RH : proche des lieux de travail, en échange direct avec les dirigeants et les employés et avec l'objectif de contribuer activement. Pour cela, nous recherchons vous - une personne RH avec un cœur, une compétence et la volonté de faire vraiment quelque chose. Vos tâches - variées et proches des personnes
• Vous êtes le premier point de contact pour les dirigeants et les employés dans plusieurs lieux de travail et accompagnez tous les sujets RH du recrutement à la sortie
• Vous prenez en charge la réquisition indépendante de professionnels et de dirigeants et accompagnez l'ensemble du processus de sélection
• Vous travaillez activement sur les processus de changement et les accompagnez de manière professionnelle et orientée vers les solutions
• Vous êtes responsable de l'administration RH complète le long du cycle de vie de l'employé
• Vous conseillez et soutenez les dirigeants de ligne pendant les processus RH annuels centraux. Votre profil - compétent et convaincant
• Éducation commerciale avec une formation supplémentaire en gestion des ressources humaines (au moins certificat d'approbation de l'État)
• Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans une position similaire
• Allemand écrit et parlé avec sécurité
• Vous êtes une personne proactive, pragmatique et autonome et vous vous présentez de manière vincolante et orientée vers les solutions
• Haute flexibilité et volonté d'être présent dans plusieurs lieux de travail
• Permis de conduire requis, car vous travaillez itinérant. Ce que nous offrons Vous trouverez avec nous une nouvelle challenge avec des tâches intéressantes et beaucoup plus :
• Beaucoup d'espace pour l'initiative personnelle et la co-création - vous apportez vos idées et vous façonnez le travail RH de manière active
• Nombreuses avantages (voitures neuves et d'occasion, travaux de service et pièces de rechange, assurance pour véhicules et maladie, cartes de carburant, hôtels, etc.)
• Un fonds de pension privé, attractif et indépendant comme organisme de prévoyance
• Une perspective d'entreprise à long terme
• Possibilités de formation et de développement individuelles
• Au moins 25 jours de congé
• Voiture de société.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automobile brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. The Kia Corporation is an innovative and rapidly growing automobile manufacturer. The Kia Switzerland AG imports and distributes as the general importer the vehicles of the Kia brand in Switzerland and in the Principality of Liechtenstein. Ready for a new job? Then apply with us. Your tasks
• Coordination of local advertising of Kia partners - from consultation to implementation to budget management
• Support for national marketing campaigns
• Operational handling of point-of-sale materials and coordination of suppliers and partners
• Maintenance of digital content on various platforms (website, car configurator, etc.)
• Contribution to social media activities, including reporting and analysis
• Support of the marketing and product team in administrative matters
• Participation in events and trade fairs - from organization to presence on site Your profile
• Completed commercial or technical basic education with a further education in the field of marketing / communication
• First work experience in a similar marketing function
• Very good knowledge of German, good English and French knowledge
• Safe handling of M365 applications; knowledge of marketing, digital or campaign tools is a plus
• Organizational talent, high service orientation and hands-on mentality
• Autonomous, structured and reliable work style
• Passion for the automobile and mobility What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more:
• numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• a own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• a long-term corporate perspective
• individual opportunities for further education and development
• at least 25 days of vacation
• personal restaurant and free parking How to contact us Jacqueline Müller, Regional Personnel Responsible and Sandra Uhlmann - Meier, Personnel Employee are looking forward to your complete application (e.g. resume, work certificates, etc.) via the link 'Apply now!'. For reasons of better readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms male, female and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means for us that people work together in teams that, due to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best possible results. We are convinced that a diverse team and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

Cosa dovresti sapere su di noi La Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. In questo modo, l'attenzione delle attività è rivolta all'importazione di marche automobilistiche, all'esercizio di garage, alla logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori, nonché alla prestazione di servizi finanziari. L'autofficina di Zürich-Altstetten - con il suo sito al centro della Gruppo Emil Frey - presenta le gamma di modelli di sei marche mondiali, nonché una vasta scelta di occasioni. Inoltre, l'azienda comprende anche le officine di marca, un reparto di carrozzeria e un magazzino di pezzi di ricambio. Il nostro piccolo team di disposizione dei veicoli cerca immediatamente o dopo accordo un Team Leader/essa Disposizione Veicoli. Le tue responsabilità
• Fornire la leadership alla disposizione dei veicoli e garantire un funzionamento senza intoppi del giorno lavorativo
• Organizzare, gestire e continuare a ottimizzare i processi di disposizione in collaborazione con le sezioni interne e i partner esterni
• Gestire autonomamente tutta la disposizione dei veicoli nuovi (ordine, controllo dei termini, coordinamento fino all'invio)
• Coordinare e comunicare con gli importatori, i fornitori e i servizi di trasporto
• Controllare i contratti di acquisto e leasing, nonché fatturare i veicoli dei clienti e dei concessionari
• Curare e gestire i dati dei veicoli e dei clienti nei sistemi pertinenti, inclusa l'iscrizione nel portale di vendita
• Assicurarsi che i documenti dei veicoli siano disponibili, partecipare alle inventarie e supportare il capo dell'amministrazione (sostituzione) Il tuo profilo
• Laurea in economia, preferibilmente nel settore automobilistico
• Esperienza plurennale nella disposizione dei veicoli
• Prima esperienza di leadership o interesse marcato per una funzione di leadership
• Deutsch scritto e parlato con sicurezza, ulteriori lingue utili
• Stile di lavoro strutturato, autonomo e orientato alle soluzioni
• Alta disponibilità, senso di responsabilità e talento organizzativo
• Personalità orientata al team con capacità di imporsi Cosa ti offriamo
• Troverai una nuova sfida con compiti affascinanti e molto altro:
• Numerose agevolazioni (nuovi e usati, lavori di servizio e pezzi di ricambio, assicurazioni dei veicoli e malattia, carte di carburante, alberghi e molto altro)
• Una pensione propria, attrattiva, come ente di previdenza indipendente
• Una prospettiva di impiego a lungo termine
• Possibilità di sviluppo e formazione individuali
• Minimo 25 giorni di ferie
• Ristorante personale Come contattarci Siamo felici di ricevere la tua candidatura completa (ad esempio, curriculum, attestati di lavoro, ecc.) via il link 'Candida ora!' Per motivi di leggibilità, si è deciso di non utilizzare contemporaneamente le forme grammaticali maschile, femminile e diverso (m/w/d). Le donne e le altre identità di genere sono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa per noi che le persone lavorano insieme in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i risultati migliori. Siamo convinti che un'ampia gamma di personale, nonché una cultura integrativa, ci consentano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.

L'attention des activités est portée sur l'importation de marques automobiles, l'exploitation de garages, la logistique de pièces de rechange et d'accessoires, ainsi que la fourniture de services financiers. L'agence de véhicules de Zurich-Altstetten - avec son emplacement au siège de la société Emil Frey - présente les gammes de modèles de six marques mondiales, ainsi qu'une large sélection de véhicules d'occasion. L'entreprise comprend également les ateliers de marques, un département de carrosserie et un entrepôt de pièces de rechange. Notre petit équipe de dispositif de véhicules cherche un Chef d'équipe/Dispositif de véhicules immédiatement ou par accord. Vos tâches
• Diriger le dispositif de véhicules et garantir une opération quotidienne fluide
• Organiser, gérer et continuer à optimiser les processus de dispositif en collaboration avec les départements internes et les partenaires externes
• Gérer de manière autonome toute la disposition de véhicules neufs (commande, suivi des délais, coordination jusqu'à la livraison)
• Coordonner et communiquer avec les importateurs, les fournisseurs et les services de transport
• Contrôler les contrats d'achat et de location, ainsi que facturer les véhicules des clients et des concessionnaires
• Maintenir et gérer les données de véhicules et de clients dans les systèmes pertinents, y compris l'inscription dans le portail de vente
• Assurer que les documents de véhicules soient disponibles, participer aux inventaires et soutenir le directeur de l'administration (sousstitut) Votre profil
• Diplôme en économie, idéalement dans l'industrie automobile

• Un fonds de pension privé, attractif, en tant qu'entité de prévoyance indépendante
• Une perspective d'entreprise à long terme
• Possibilités de développement et de formation individuelles
• Au moins 25 jours de congé

Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Biel is the official sales and/or service partner of the brands Subaru, Jaguar / Land Rover, Toyota, Kia, and Suzuki. We are looking for reinforcement for our team in Biel as of May 1, 2026 or by agreement. Your tasks
• You take care of the success-oriented and active sales of our broad model palette
• From the first contact, you care for our customers, advise them on the vehicle selection and the various financing and insurance options
• You ensure the successful delivery of the vehicle and the follow-up contact (especially customer satisfaction)
• The daily care of your existing customer base and the acquisition of new customers are part of your tasks, as well as the management and care of the vehicle park
• The care of our online appearance of the vehicles (announcement, photos, etc.)

• Your commercial flair, your customer and service orientation, and your communicative strength characterize you
• A high level of personal motivation, assertiveness, and passion for cars complete your profile
• You are fascinated by new technologies, trends, and IT and have a high level of flexibility and willingness to learn
• You speak at least two languages (DE and FR) and hold a category B driving license

We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automobile brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey Mobility AG is a competence center for integrated mobility services around the car. This includes vehicle insurance, but also our own financing companies. You will enjoy:

• Be proactive and question common processes. What you bring with you:

• You have a strong sense of numbers and feel comfortable in financial processes.
• You express yourself in German with confidence.
• French or Italian language skills are an advantage.
• With MS Office, as well as CRM and internal systems, you move with ease and navigate safely in digital work environments.
• You are ready to question processes, think digitally, and implement new solutions. Why Emil Frey Mobility AG?

• The opportunity to actively contribute to the development and orientation of Multilease with your ideas.
• You can expect a positive work environment based on teamwork and respect.
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more).

Join our HR team and help shape the future of Emil Frey Mobility! The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. Our activities focus on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, as well as the provision of financial services. At Emil Frey Mobility, we rely on a trusting and respectful collaboration. As an HR Generalist (100%), you will play an important role in shaping our HR processes and supporting our team with your expertise. If you appreciate a dynamic work environment and work with a positive and proactive attitude, you're in the right place! Here's what you can expect:
• You are the first point of contact for all administrative HR matters and support the team in all processes.
• You help with the coordination and execution of recruitment activities, from the publication of the announcement to the preparation of the interview with superiors and the drafting of the contract.
• You bring your affinity for numbers and support in preparing and processing the monthly payroll.
• From creating certificates of employment to other personal documents - you always keep track.
• You have successfully completed a commercial training and have already gained experience in HR administration. A training as HR Assistant is desired.
• Your German flows smoothly, you have a good level of English and bring good French skills, so you can also support and recruit our employees in the Romandie region.
• You feel comfortable with numbers.
• As an open personality, you work well in teams and with a positive attitude, you contribute to our success as a team.
• You are willing to go the extra mile, feel driven by changes and with your excellent administrative and multitasking skills, you can dance on different occasions without losing track. Why Emil Frey Mobility AG? In addition to our exceptional team, our passion for innovation, and the opportunity to contribute to the future growth of Emil Frey Mobility AG, we offer other benefits:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Our own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term perspective for the company
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation If you feel involved in this position and want to become part of our committed HR team, we would be happy to get to know you better! Let's work together on the future of Emil Frey Mobility. We are looking forward to receiving your application! How you can contact us Michelle Salina, HR Generalist, looks forward to receiving the complete application (e.g., curriculum, certificates of employment, etc.) via the link 'Apply now!'. For reasons of readability, we have decided not to use the grammatical forms male, female, and diverse (m/w/d) simultaneously. Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. We are convinced that a multilingual and integrative culture enables us to tap into our full potential.
• You are willing to go the extra mile and feel driven by changes and with your excellent administrative and multitasking skills, you can dance on different occasions without losing track.

Join our HR team and help shape the future of Emil Frey Mobility! The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of automobile brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessory parts, and the provision of financial services. At Emil Frey Mobility, we rely on a trusting and respectful collaboration. We can build our team and are therefore looking for an HR Assistant (100%). In this function, you will play an important role in efficiently managing HR processes and supporting the team with your expertise. If you appreciate a dynamic work environment and work with a positive and proactive attitude, you are exactly the right person for us! Here's what you can expect:
• You will be the first point of contact for all administrative HR matters and support the team in all processes.
• You will help with the coordination and implementation of recruitment activities, from the posting of the announcement to the preparation of the interview with the superiors and the drafting of the contract.
• You will bring your affinity for numbers and support with the preparation and processing of the monthly salary calendar.
• From creating work certificates to other personal documents - you will always keep track. You have:
• A completed commercial basic education with success and bring already some experience in HR administration. A further education in the HR area is of advantage.
• Your German flows smoothly, you have a good English and bring good French knowledge, so that you can also care for and recruit our employees in the Romandie.

The Emil Frey Digital AG belongs to the Emil Frey Group and is a full-service communication service provider for the automotive industry, as well as responsible for digitalization within the Emil Frey Group. To strengthen our team in Zurich Oerlikon, we are looking for a Customer Service Manager to start immediately or after an agreement. Your tasks
• Professional handling of customer inquiries via telephone, e-mail, and other digital channels
• Taking, qualifying, and documenting of inquiries (e.g. in JIRA)
• Supporting customers in the analysis and resolution of problems related to our technical products and services
• Coordination of responses and tracking until a clean case closure

• Ensuring efficient and transparent communication between customers and internal departments

• First work experience in customer service or in a similar function
• Basic understanding of technical products or SaaS solutions; willingness to learn our solutions (INSiDE, Carmarket)
• Team-oriented, flexible work style and high service orientation
• High social competence and pleasure in direct contact with customers, even in challenging situations
• Careful, structured work style and good time management
• Willingness to take responsibility for cases and to bring them actively to a close
• JIRA basic knowledge or experience with similar ticketing systems

• A long-term corporate perspective

• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us. We are happy to receive your complete application (e.g. curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". jobs.title: Reifenpraktiker/-in Pneulager
jobs.description:
Was Sie über uns wissen sollten Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey Betriebs AG erbringt Logistikdienstleistungen für Waren und Fahrzeuge und ist somit die Drehscheibe im Warenfluss zwischen unseren Kunden und deren Endverbraucher. Im September 2026 eröffnen wir unser neues Pneulager in Niederglatt . Um eine reibungslose Inbetriebnahme sicherzustellen, suchen wir bereits heute Mitarbeitende, die zuvor in unserem Pneulager in Härkingen eingearbeitet werden. Nutzen Sie die Chance, von Beginn an beim Aufbau sowie bei der Neueröffnung dabei zu sein und bewerben Sie sich noch heute. Ihre Aufgaben
• Montieren und auswuchten von Rädern und Reifen
• Mitarbeit in der Logistik, von Wareneingang bis -ausgang

jobs.title: Automobildiagnostiker/-in
jobs.description:
Was Sie über uns wissen sollten Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Das Autohaus Zürich-Altstetten – mit seinem Standort am Hauptsitz der Emil Frey Gruppe – präsentiert die Modellpaletten von sieben Weltmarken sowie eine grosse Auswahl an Occasionen. Zum Betrieb gehören weiter die Markenwerkstätten, eine Carrosserieabteilung sowie ein Ersatzteillager. Ihre Aufgaben
• Durchführung von Diagnose-, Reparatur- und Wartungsarbeiten gemäss Herstellervorgaben
• Analyse und Behebung von technischen und elektronischen Störungen mit modernen Diagnosesystemen
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards, sowie Unterstützung des Werkstattleiters
• Regelmässige Teilnahme an markenspezifischen Weiterbildungen und Kursen Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Automobilmechatroniker EFZ mit der Weiterbildung als Automobildiagnostiker
• Fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Fahrzeugdiagnose
• Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Vorgehensweise
• Hohes Mass an Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Zuverlässigkeit, Engagement und Zielstrebigkeit

jobs.description:
Was Du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey Mobility AG ist ein Kompetenz-Zentrum für integrierte Mobilitäts-Dienstleistungen rund um's Auto. Dazu gehören Fahrzeugversicherungen, aber auch unsere eigenen Finanzierungsgesellschaften. Darauf kannst du dich freuen: Du hast ein Auge fürs Detail, denkst risikobewusst und schätzt Verantwortung? Dann gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Mobilitätsfinanzierung! Bei uns erwartet dich eine spannende Position mit Wirkung: Du prüfst nicht einfach Anträge, du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Leasinggeschäfte sicher, effizient und kundenorientiert abgewickelt werden.
• Prüfung von Leasinganträgen auf Vollständigkeit, Plausibilität und Qualität
• Durchführung gesetzeskonformer Bonitäts- und Risikoanalysen (GWG, KKG)
• Bearbeitung von Vertragsänderungen wie Umschreibungen und Verlängerungen
• Telefonische & schriftliche Beratung von Händlern, Partnern und Endkunden
• Unterstützung des Aussendienstes bei der Umsetzung unserer Vertriebsstrategie Das bringst du mit:
• Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung. Idealerweise mit Erfahrung im Finanz- oder Mobilitätsbereich.
• Du bringst Berufserfahrung in der Antragsprüfung oder im Leasing-/Kreditwesen mit.
• Gesetzliche Vorgaben wie das GWG und KKG sind dir vertraut und du kannst Bonitäten einschätzen.
• Der Umgang mit Vertragsunterlagen sowie digitalen CRM- und Finanzierungssystemen fällt dir leicht.
• Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst analytisch und behältst auch unter Zeitdruck den Überblick.
• Du kommunizierst klar und professionell. Auf Deutsch stilsicher, auf Französisch sehr gut, Italienisch ist ein Plus.
• Du bist kundenorientiert, teamfähig und bringst die Bereitschaft mit, dich laufend fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Was wir Dir bieten Nebst der Möglichkeit die Zukunft der Mobilität mitzugestalten und Autoträume zu verwirklichen bieten wir weitere Benefits:
• Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen legen wir Wert auf langfristige Beziehungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum.
• Die Chance, den Ausbau und die Ausrichtung von Emil Frey Mobility AG mit deinen Ideen aktiv mitzugestalten.
• Bei uns erwartet dich eine positive Arbeitsumgebung, die auf Teamgeist und Respekt basiert.
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Wir investieren in deine Weiterbildung und bieten dir zahlreiche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Wie Du uns kontaktieren kannst Michelle Salina, Mitarbeiterin Personal freut sich auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet.
